T=G['Test input']
def solve(G):
    import numpy as np
    A=np.array(G)
    h,w=A.shape
    bg=np.bincount(A.flatten()).argmax()
    out=A.copy()
    # find maximal rectangles: for each color != bg, flood from top-left seeds
    seen=np.zeros_like(A,bool)
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v=A[r,c]
            if v==bg or seen[r,c]: continue
            # grow to full rectangle anchored at (r,c)
            r2=c2=r-1;c2=w;cnt=0
            # try expand down/right filling color v
            rr,cc=r,c; ok=True
            while rr<h and cc<w and A[rr,cc]==v:
                seen[rr,cc]=True; cnt+=1; rr+=1
            while rr<h and cc>w: pass
            # instead: bounding box of connected component containing (r,c)
            st=[(r,c)]; comp=[]
            seen[r,c]=True
            while st:
                x,y=st.pop(); comp.append((x,y))
                for dx,dy in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    p=(x+dx,y+dy)
                    if 0<=p[0]<h and 0<=p[1]<w and not seen[p] and A[p]==v:
                        seen[p]=True; st.append(p)
            rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
            for i in range(min(rs),max(rs)+1):
                for j in range(min(cs),max(cs)+1):
                    if A[i,j]!=v:
                        out[i,j]=v
    return out.tolist()
